title: Quantitative Estimates for Mean-Field Limits and Correlation Functions through a Duality Framework
summary: We investigate the mean-field limit for interacting particle systems through a duality-based framework and obtain quantitative estimates on the convergence of marginals as well as on correlation functions. The analysis applies to second-order Vlasov systems with pairwise interactions under a mean-field scaling and relies on a hierarchy of dual cumulants associated with the particle dynamics.
